fee_notes: Standard Restaurant IFF ranges $5,000-$25,000 depending on incentives and negotiations. Non-Traditional and Small-Town Restaurant IFF is flat $5,000. Development Fee Deposit ($5,000-$25,000 per restaurant) is credited against IFF. Fees are non-uniform for standard restaurants.
raw_excerpt: Depending on if you qualify for one of our incentives, the Initial Franchise Fee for a standard Restaurant will range from $5,000 to $25,000 and is non-refundable. The Initial Franchise Fee for a Non-Traditional Restaurant and a Small Town Restaurant is $5,000 and is non-refundable.
